attempts.summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (CentOS Stream 10) at /etc/pki/local-ca/, installed it into the system trust store via /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors + update-ca-trust extract, and confirmed it is trusted (trust anchor, openssl verify OK). Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot id and CA state, restarted node1 with `shutdown -r now`, confirmed the boot id changed after reconnect, and re-verified the CA anchor and trust status post-restart.
